crossRefs.note: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of…
“Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am…
“Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You were the seal of…
Speak and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in…
At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.
“You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.
“Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will…
Now is the end on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you…

translations.web: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.
translations.bsb: You said, ‘I will be queen forever.’ You did not take these things to heart or consider their outcome.
translations.kjv: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end
translations.asv: And thou saidst, I shall be mistress for ever; so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end thereof.
